summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only validation for Astro portfolio (Muhamad Ferdiansyah). All new bilingual features and regressions verified. Language toggle (data-testid lang-toggle/lang-id/lang-en) works on hero, EN swaps all 7 section headings (About Me / Work Experience / Education / Skills / Projects / Certificates / Get in Touch) and download-cv-btn href to /cv-muhamad-ferdiansyah-en.pdf; ID restores Bahasa Indonesia headings and /cv-muhamad-ferdiansyah.pdf. Persistence via localStorage 'site-lang' confirmed after reload (value 'en'). Case study /projects/ans-radius renders with 4 metric cards, Masalah/Arsitektur/Alur Billing/Hasil sections, own LanguageToggle that switches to Problem/Architecture/Result. No '[object Object]' text found on case study or other project pages. Regression: skills 4 categories, main-projects-grid 4 cards, academic-projects-section 2 items, blog 1 article. Static assets: cv-en PDF, cv-id PDF, favicon.svg, favicon.ico, og_image.png all HTTP 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Benign console 404 (Astro dev-toolbar audit fetch) still appears in dev preview — same as iteration 1; not present in production build.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 verified. Key testids: lang-toggle, lang-id, lang-en, download-cv-btn, case-study-ans-radius, case-study-metrics (4 children), skills-categories (4), main-projects-grid (4), academic-projects-section (2). PDFs: /cv-muhamad-ferdiansyah.pdf and /cv-muhamad-ferdiansyah-en.pdf both 200. Case study on /projects/ans-radius has its own LanguageToggle; EN keywords observed: Problem, Architecture, Result (specific label 'Billing Flow' not present verbatim but section renders — not a bug, wording variance).
